title: Flip Columns For Maximum Number of Equal Rows
description:
You are given a binary matrix matrix of size m × n.

You can:

Choose any column
Flip that entire column (change 0 → 1 and 1 → 0 for all rows)
Task

After performing any number of column flips, return the maximum number of rows that become identical
(i.e., all values in those rows are the same as each other).

Key Idea
You are trying to make as many rows as possible look exactly the same
You can flip columns to help match rows
Examples

Example 1

Input: [[0,1],[1,1]]
Output: 1

Example 2

Input: [[0,1],[1,0]]
Output: 2

Example 3

Input: [[0,0,0],[0,0,1],[1,1,0]]
Output: 2
Constraints
1 ≤ m, n ≤ 300
Each cell is 0 or 1
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
